education.summary: Four diodes steer both halves of the AC waveform through the load in the same direction; the capacitor smooths the result.
objectives: Trace the current path for each half-cycle
Explain why two diode drops are lost
Compare ripple with the half-wave rectifier
education.theory: On each half-cycle one diagonal pair conducts, so the load sees current every half-cycle: Vpeak ≈ Vac·√2 − 2·Vf and the ripple frequency is twice the mains frequency.
questions: Which diodes conduct while V1.positive is above V1.negative?
What is the ripple frequency for a 50 Hz input?
What happens if one diode fails open?
